questions.q: Maria is at the airport with ___ husband.
questions.explainRo: Soțul este al Mariei (o femeie), deci folosim **her** — contează cine are, nu ce are.

questions.q: Sara is Tom's wife. Tom is Sara's ___.
questions.explainRo: Bărbatul cu care este căsătorită o femeie este **husband** (soț).

questions.q: Ben is my ___ (coleg de echipă). He's a great designer.
Our client ___ got a big company in Germany.
questions.explainRo: Our client = he/she, deci folosim **has got**.

questions.q: The hotel is nice, but ___ restaurant is very small.
questions.explainRo: Pentru lucruri folosim **its** (al lui / al ei); **it's** înseamnă „it is”.

questions.q: Has your sister got a car? — No, she ___.
questions.explainRo: La întrebarea **Has she got...?** răspundem scurt cu **has / hasn't**: No, she hasn't.

questions.q: Sorry, I ___ got your phone number. (not / have)
questions.explainRo: Cu **I** negația este **haven't got** / **have not got**.
Întâi proprietarul cu 's (**my sister's**), apoi persoana (**husband**).

questions.audio: Her son hasn't got a phone.
answers: Her son hasn't got a phone.
Her son has not got a phone.
questions.explainRo: **Her** = al ei; son = he, deci negația este **hasn't got**.

questions.ro: Bunicii lui Sorin au un câine și o pisică.
answers: Sorin's grandparents have got a dog and a cat.
Sorin's grandparents have a dog and a cat.
Sorin’s grandparents have got a dog and a cat.
Sorin’s grandparents have a dog and a cat.
questions.explainRo: Bunicii lui Sorin = **Sorin's grandparents**; sunt mai mulți (they), deci **have got**, nu „has got”.
